name: codex-research-orchestrator
description: Coordinate research with Boost challenge-and-repair, Swarm tracks, Teamwork milestones, and a local collaboration workbench.

interface.shortDescription: Research collaboration with a visual local workbench
interface.longDescription: Run Boost investigations, parallel Swarm tracks, or dependent Teamwork milestones within the user's scope. Coordinate evidence, revisions, and results among authorized collaborators using persistent project records and an optional MCP runtime.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-research-orchestrator to start or continue my research within the recorded scope and resource limits.
Use $boost to challenge and verify the proposed fix.
Use $swarm to investigate the independent parts of this question and integrate the evidence.
Use $teamwork to deliver this project through its milestones and final audit.
